worlds.name: Mirror Lab
worlds.intro: Tap a mirror to flip it. Light every crystal.

worlds.name: Filter Works
worlds.intro: Filters only let their own color through.

worlds.name: Color Studio
worlds.intro: Colored glass mixes colors: red + yellow = orange.

worlds.name: Warp Gallery
worlds.intro: Drag the handled mirrors into place. Portals bend space.

worlds.name: Twin Observatory
worlds.intro: Twin mirrors are linked: flip one and its twin flips too.

worlds.name: Shadow Vault
worlds.intro: Shadow crystals must stay dark. Don't let any beam touch them.

worlds.name: Deep Sea
worlds.intro: Light fades in the deep: beams can only bounce so many times.

worlds.name: Prism Peaks
worlds.intro: Prisms split white light: red turns left, yellow goes straight, blue turns right.

worlds.name: Circuit Temple
worlds.intro: Light one crystal to open the gate for another beam.
